Decision: Use package-level fast-track acceptance for remaining ordinary user-mode packages. Verify the official source and pinned artifact, install/remove on the disposable Windows VM, verify owned-file cleanup/recovery, and confirm Defender remains active without an alert. Do not require per-tool feature tests for included utilities unless RIDE itself invokes/configures them. Batch products sharing a publisher or installer where practical. Reserve focused checks or deferral for drivers/kernel components, services/persistence, credential/key-recovery behavior, and Defender alerts. Never bypass Defender; pause an alerted artifact for investigation.
